title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pallavan receives vital family support as Nadesan, Pandian and Nila unknowingly give him money. Cheran visits his college with money, checking if Chandayatha's words have hurt him.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj accuses Malar of waking up late deliberately and blames her for their frequent clashes. Hurt by his harsh words, Malar leaves home with Ragavi for her mother's house.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Devastated by Sethupathi's denied bail, Mohana tells Rajangam about Vellathai's blindness. Mohana begs camp victims for forgiveness and Aishwarya seeks Tamizhselvi's help.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kamala makes Kasthuri wash clothes during her exams. Pooja reveals she cleared Aadhavan's father of false charges, raising his hopes for his father's acceptance of their love.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajasekar and Sivagami rejoice in their 60th wedding anniversary celebrations, filled with dance and music. Later, Kanmani alerts Anbu to the threat posed by the intruders.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Amid rising coconut prices, Kandhasamy surprises the family with dishes made without them. Indhira takes Sarasu to the hospital to treat her sleeplessness due to work pressure.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi rejoices over the newborn while Thangamayil rejects Bhagyam and Manickam when they visit to see the newborn kid. Later, Saravanan steps in to help Thangamayil.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Seetha Uses Karate on Doubting Arun
description: Muthu lies to Meena about Chandra. Later, Seetha uses karate on suspicious Arun and tells Meena about the fight, while Vijaya buys Meena mangoes and bans sharing them with Rohini.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sudar moves Vetri by drawing him into the family photo as he stays away due to Abinaya's rejection. Meanwhile, Sandhya confronts rival Maran after winning a new contract.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar notices Poongodi struggling with stomach pain and grows concerned about her condition. He then rushes her to the hospital on his bike late at night for medical care.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Nalini faints during the Pooja, and her pregnancy shocks Sidharth and Kalamma. Ranjitham, following Kalamma's plan, taunts Ilamathi for not conceiving yet.
